system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: This prompt is repeatedly given to the agent until it converges in about 8 hours
system_prompt_style.note: The paper describes the prompt only in prose, with no mechanism. Agents also follow a 234-line CLAUDE.md rules file (Sec. 3).

env_context_strategy.note: No harness code is in the bundle. The agents run inside Claude Code and Codex, whose context strategy is not described.

context_compaction.note: No harness config or run loop is available.

observation_format.note: The paper says Megalodon error messages were made more readable. The observation format itself is not specified.

tool_call_format.note: The tool-call format is delegated to Claude Code and Codex and is not described.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: they can invoke tactics, inspect proof states and goals, analyze tactic successes and failures, and iteratively refine their proof scripts
loop_primitives.note: The paper describes an iterative prove-check-refine loop against Megalodon.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: The resulting file with the background theory and the newly created 230 definitions and 393 toplevel theorems (with the effort-based bounties) is then used as the start
planning_granularity.note: The shared statement file with bounties and locks acts as a blueprint that all agents re-read.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: We ultimately used four LLM agents (named Alice, Bob, Charlie and Dave)
multi_agent_topology.note: The agents compete and collaborate as equals through a bounty marketplace. There is no orchestrator.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Agents can issue sub-bounties, solve others' bounties
delegation_mechanism.note: This is the closest value. Coordination happens through a shared git repo holding bounties and locks (pull-commit-push).

human_in_loop.note: Admins intervene manually (e.g. resetting balances), but no gating mechanism is described.

long_term_memory.note: The CLAUDE.md rules and TODO comments in the shared files persist, but no memory mechanism is described.

self_verification.evidence_quote: All accepted proofs are ultimately checked and verified by the underlying proof assistant.
self_verification.note: Guard scripts that check bounty and lock invariants are run by the agents before committing.

rollback.note: Work is kept in git and regular backups are mentioned, but no rollback mechanism is described.

cost_controls.note: The runs used flat-rate subscriptions. No budget mechanism is described.

timeouts.note: The 24-hour lock expiry is a marketplace rule, not a timeout.

filesystem_access.note: The rules forbid editing outside the AlgTop section, but this is prompt-level only.

permission_model.note: The guard scripts are run locally by the agents, not as a blocking hook.

tracing.note: The analysis uses the git commit history. No tracing facility is described.

guardrails.evidence_quote: The Qed command is now blocked for proofs that are complete but whose dependencies were only partially proved.
guardrails.note: Guard scripts also enforce statement immutability and lock rules before commit.

target_domain.evidence_quote: We describe an experiment in large-scale autoformalization of algebraic topology in an Interactive Theorem Proving (ITP) environment
target_domain.note: The domain is formal mathematics / autoformalization.

open_source.note: No LICENSE file is in the evidence.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: using two ChatGPT Pro Codex 5.3 models and two Claude Code (Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6) models
model_agnostic.note: Multiple vendors are used, each through its own agent CLI. There is no abstraction layer.

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: The evolving public repository is athttps://github.com/mgwiki/alg_top.
primary_artifact.note: The bundled repo (mgw_test) is the Megalodon wiki, not harness code. The agent harness itself is described only in the paper.

first_release_date.note: This is the paper v1 date (fallback).

pinned_version.note: The bundled repo is mgwiki/mgw_test, but the record's repo_url is mgwiki/alg_top. Not tagged.

stars.note: This is the star count for mgw_test, not the record's alg_top repo. Date unknown.
